units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 85b:15">B. Kam. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>הכהו … וצָמְתָה ידו וכ׳</he> if one struck his neighbor on his hand, and his hand was smashed, but is expected to recover; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:5:3">Y. Naz. IX, end, 58ᵃ</cite>

senses.gloss: to contract; to reduce a swelling by applications of vinegar, wine &c.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 40a:5">Pes. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>שורן … וחומץ צוֹמְתָן</he> he steeps the barley-corns in vinegar, and this binds them (prevents moisture from penetrating and creating fermentation); v. <cite ref="R00669"><he>צָפַד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 109a:5">Sabb. 109ᵃ</cite> … <he>מי שנגפה צוֹמְתָהּ ביין</he> (Ar. <he>בחומץ</he>) he whose hand or foot was struck, may apply wine (vinegar) to reduce the swelling (on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite>, end <he>אבותיך מְצַמְּתִים ואתה מבזבז</he> thy ancestors saved, and thou squanderest; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 140:2">Yalk. ib. 140</cite> <he>מְצַמְצְמִין</he>; Yalk. Chr. 1074 <he>מצומצמים</he> (read <he>מצמ׳</he>).

senses.gloss: to gather together, summon to a meeting. Y’lamd. to Gen. XLVI, 28 quot. in Ar. (play on צמתך, Cant. IV, 1) שהוא מְצַמְּתָן … בצמאה he summons them to the synagogues, and they drink the words of the Law with thirst.—Part. pass. מְצוּמָּת; pl. מְצוּמָּתִים, מְצוּמָּתִין

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:7:1">Cant. R. to VI, 7</cite> (ref. to <he>צמתך</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:7:1">ib.</cite>) <he>על הצנועין ועל המצ׳ שבכם</he> of the chaste and self-controlled among you.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: summoned to follow, follower. Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 70ᵇ (ref. to צמים, Job V, 5) אברהם וכל המצ׳ לו Abraham and all his followers; Lev. R. s. 28; Pesik. R. s. 18; Yalk. Job 898.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be quashed; (denom. of צְמִיתוּת) to be sold for ever, not to be recovered in the jubilee.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 79a:12">B. Mets. 79ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>לצמיתת</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 25:30">Lev. XXV, 30</cite>) <he>מי שאין שם יובל נִצְמֶתֶת וכ׳</he> that which without the law concerning the jubilee would be sold for ever, is recovered by dint of the jubilee; <he>יצאת זו … אינה נצמתת</he> which excludes a case like this (a sale for sixty years), where the sale would not be perpetual even if the law of jubilee did not exist at all.
